g.text: Find the characteristic and minimal polynomials of
Let A be an n × n complex matrix. Show that A is
diagonalisable if and only if its minimal polynomial
mA(t) has no repeated roots. Deduce that if
Ak = I for some k ≥ 1 then A is diagonalisable.
Let α be an endomorphism of a finite-dimensional
complex vector space V with α3 = α. What are the
possible Jordan normal forms of α?
Show that two 3 × 3 complex matrices are similar if
and only if they have the same characteristic and
minimal polynomials. Is this true for 4 × 4?
